children: Sunday it has withdrawn from the sale process for FleetPartners Group, deciding not to submit a revised proposal after completing its phase 1 review.
The company said continuing in a competitive process did not provide a certain pathway to a transaction that would deliver a compelling risk-adjusted return.

“FleetPartners is a high-quality business, and we continue to believe there is strategic merit in combining the two businesses,” CEO Laura Dottori-Attanasio said. However, the company concluded that the risk-adjusted return did not justify continuing as the process became increasingly competitive.

title: Element Fleet drops bid for FleetPartners after review
